description.en: Economics is the study of how societies allocate scarce resources to meet unlimited wants. It has two main branches: microeconomics (individual markets) and macroeconomics (the whole economy).
description.hi: अर्थशास्त्र इस बात का अध्ययन है कि समाज सीमित संसाधनों का आवंटन कैसे करते हैं। इसकी दो शाखाएं हैं: सूक्ष्म अर्थशास्त्र और स्थूल अर्थशास्त्र।

lyrics.en:
[Verse 1]
Open up the books, let the learning start,
Economics lives in every market and every cart,
Micro looks at firms and the choices that we make,
Macro sees the whole — the nation's path to take.

[Chorus]
Economics, economics — it's how the world decides,
Where the money flows, where the value hides,
From the smallest trade to the grandest plan,
Understanding choices is where it all began.

[Verse 2]
Scarcity is real, wants are never done,
Resources have their limits under every sun,
But with the right knowledge, we can find our way,
Economics lights the path, every single day.

topics.reason: The song's upbeat energy and modern style mirror the dynamic, foundational nature of economics — always evolving, always relevant.

description.en: Economic systems determine how resources are allocated. The three main types are capitalism (market-driven), socialism (state-controlled), and mixed economy (combination of both).
description.hi: आर्थिक प्रणालियां तय करती हैं कि संसाधनों का आवंटन कैसे होगा। तीन मुख्य प्रकार हैं: पूंजीवाद, समाजवाद और मिश्रित अर्थव्यवस्था।

lyrics.en:
[Verse 1]
Three roads diverge in how nations run,
Capitalism lets the free market have its fun,
Socialism says the state should hold the key,
Mixed economy blends them both — that's what we see.

[Chorus]
Systems, systems, shaping every land,
Private hands or public plans, help us understand,
Markets move and governments guide,
In this economic world, we all decide.

[Verse 2]
India chose the middle ground — a mixed design,
Private enterprise with a public lifeline,
Every system has its strengths and its cost,
Learning how they work means nothing's lost.

topics.reason: Just as different music genres coexist, capitalism, socialism, and mixed economies represent different approaches to organizing society's resources.

name.en: Problem of Scarcity of Economic Resources
name.hi: आर्थिक संसाधनों की कमी की समस्या

description.en: Scarcity is the fundamental economic problem — unlimited wants but limited resources. Every choice has an opportunity cost: what you give up to get something else.
description.hi: कमी मूल आर्थिक समस्या है — असीमित इच्छाएं लेकिन सीमित संसाधन। हर पसंद की एक अवसर लागत होती है।

lyrics.en:
[Verse 1]
Unlimited wants but the resources are few,
Every single choice means something we can't do,
That's the opportunity cost we need to weigh,
Scarcity's the reason economics saves the day.

[Chorus]
Choose wisely, choose well,
Every trade-off has a story it can tell,
When you pick one path, another fades away,
That's the price of choice we all must pay.

[Verse 2]
Land and labor, capital in hand,
These are scarce resources spread across the land,
Allocating wisely, that's the central theme,
Economics turns the scarcity into a stream.

topics.reason: Like choosing between songs on a playlist, scarcity forces us to make choices — every choice has an opportunity cost of what we give up.

description.en: Demand is how much consumers want to buy at different prices. Supply is how much producers offer. Together, they determine market prices through the laws of demand and supply.
description.hi: मांग बताती है कि उपभोक्ता विभिन्न कीमतों पर कितना खरीदना चाहते हैं। आपूर्ति बताती है कि उत्पादक कितना बेचना चाहते हैं।

lyrics.en:
[Verse 1]
When the price goes high, buyers step away,
When the price comes down, more demand comes into play,
That's the law of demand — simple, clean, and clear,
Higher price means less is what consumers want to hear.

[Chorus]
Demand and supply, supply and demand,
Together they shape the price across the land,
When they meet in the middle, the market finds its beat,
Equilibrium is where the two compete.

[Verse 2]
Suppliers want more when the price is right,
Higher prices mean more goods come into sight,
Law of supply says produce when returns are high,
Together with demand, they tell us where prices lie.

topics.reason: The push and pull in music mirrors demand and supply — when a song is popular (high demand), it gets more airplay (supply responds).

description.en: The demand curve slopes downward (higher price means less demand). The supply curve slopes upward (higher price means more supply). Where they cross is equilibrium.
description.hi: मांग वक्र नीचे की ओर झुकता है (अधिक कीमत = कम मांग)। आपूर्ति वक्र ऊपर की ओर झुकता है। जहां वे मिलते हैं वह संतुलन है।

lyrics.en:
[Verse 1]
Draw a line that slopes from high to low,
That's the demand curve — as price drops, purchases grow,
Now draw another rising from the left to right,
Supply curve shows producers ready for the fight.

[Chorus]
Curves that cross, curves that meet,
Where demand meets supply is the market's heartbeat,
Equilibrium point — the balance we all need,
Where buyers and sellers silently agree.

[Verse 2]
Below the crossing point, demand exceeds the store,
Above it, surplus grows as supply creates much more,
The curves reveal the truth behind every marketplace,
Economics in a graph — elegant and full of grace.

topics.reason: Like a melody's rising and falling notes, demand and supply curves move in opposite directions to find their equilibrium point.

description.en: Market equilibrium is the price where quantity demanded equals quantity supplied. At this point, there is no surplus or shortage in the market.
description.hi: बाजार संतुलन वह कीमत है जहां मांग की मात्रा आपूर्ति की मात्रा के बराबर होती है। इस बिंदु पर कोई अधिशेष या कमी नहीं होती।

topics.reason: A perfect harmony in music is like market equilibrium — the right balance where buyers and sellers agree on the price.

description.en: Demand and supply curves shift when non-price factors change — income, preferences, technology, input costs. Shifts change the equilibrium price and quantity.
description.hi: जब गैर-मूल्य कारक बदलते हैं तो मांग और आपूर्ति वक्र बदलते हैं — आय, प्राथमिकताएं, प्रौद्योगिकी आदि।

topics.reason: Just as a song's popularity can shift with trends and tastes, demand and supply curves shift when external factors change.

description.en: Elasticity measures how responsive demand or supply is to price changes. Elastic goods see big quantity changes; inelastic goods show little response. This affects revenue.
description.hi: लोच मापती है कि मांग या आपूर्ति कीमत परिवर्तन पर कितनी प्रतिक्रियाशील है। यह राजस्व को प्रभावित करती है।

topics.reason: Elasticity is like how audiences respond to price changes — some fans will pay anything (inelastic), others are price-sensitive (elastic).

description.en: Markets range from perfect competition (many sellers, identical products) to monopoly (single seller). In between are oligopoly (few sellers) and monopolistic competition.
description.hi: बाजार पूर्ण प्रतिस्पर्धा (कई विक्रेता) से एकाधिकार (एक विक्रेता) तक होते हैं। बीच में अल्पाधिकार और एकाधिकारी प्रतिस्पर्धा हैं।

lyrics.en:
[Verse 1]
Perfect competition — many sellers, same product line,
Monopoly means one firm — all the power is mine,
Oligopoly — just a few control the game,
Monopolistic competition — similar but not the same.

[Chorus]
Competition drives the market, shapes the price we pay,
From perfect to imperfect, in every single way,
Understanding structures helps us see the light,
How market power determines what is wrong or right.

[Verse 2]
Barriers to entry, product differentiation,
Price-making power across every station,
The spectrum of competition tells a market's tale,
From free and open trading to a single scale.

topics.reason: The music industry shows all forms of competition — from indie artists (perfect competition) to major label dominance (oligopoly).

description.en: Governments use industrial policies like licensing, subsidies, tariffs, and regulations to influence industry growth and protect consumer interests.
description.hi: सरकारें लाइसेंसिंग, सब्सिडी और नियमों जैसी औद्योगिक नीतियों का उपयोग उद्योग विकास को प्रभावित करने के लिए करती हैं।

topics.reason: Government policies shape industries like music regulations shape the entertainment industry — through licensing, content guidelines, and taxation.

description.en: Money flows in a circle: households provide labor to firms, firms pay wages, households buy goods, firms earn revenue. This is the circular flow of income.
description.hi: धन एक चक्र में बहता है: परिवार श्रम देते हैं, फर्म मजदूरी देती हैं, परिवार सामान खरीदते हैं। यह आय का चक्रीय प्रवाह है।

topics.reason: Money flows in circles like a beat loops — from households to firms and back, creating the rhythm of the economy.

description.en: GDP measures the total value of goods and services produced within a country. GNP includes income earned abroad. Both measure a nation's economic health.
description.hi: जीडीपी देश के भीतर उत्पादित वस्तुओं और सेवाओं का कुल मूल्य मापता है। जीएनपी में विदेश से अर्जित आय भी शामिल है।

lyrics.en:
[Verse 1]
GDP counts everything produced within our land,
Goods and services combined — isn't that grand?
GNP goes further, adds income from abroad,
Measuring a nation's wealth, these metrics are the rod.

[Chorus]
National income, tell me how we grow,
GDP and GNP — the numbers that we know,
Counting every factory, every service, every trade,
This is how a country's economic health is weighed.

[Verse 2]
Nominal GDP shows the current price in play,
Real GDP adjusts for inflation's sway,
Per capita tells us what each person earns,
National income accounting — a concept every student learns.

topics.reason: GDP and GNP measure a nation's economic output — like chart rankings measure a song's commercial success and reach.

description.en: Inflation is a sustained rise in the general price level. Cost-push inflation comes from rising production costs; demand-pull inflation comes from excess demand. CPI tracks it.
description.hi: मुद्रास्फीति सामान्य मूल्य स्तर में निरंतर वृद्धि है। लागत-पुश उत्पादन लागत से आती है; मांग-पुल अत्यधिक मांग से आती है।

lyrics.en:
[Verse 1]
Prices climbing higher, month by month they grow,
That's inflation knocking at everybody's door, you know,
Cost-push means production costs are on the rise,
Demand-pull means too much money chasing limited supplies.

[Chorus]
Inflation, inflation — rising every day,
CPI tracks the changes in what consumers pay,
Too much is a problem, a little keeps things right,
Balancing the pressure is the central banker's fight.

[Verse 2]
The consumer price index measures what we spend,
On food and fuel and housing — watching every trend,
Moderate inflation can signal a growing land,
But hyperinflation spirals out of hand.

topics.reason: Inflation rises like concert ticket prices over the years — driven by rising costs (cost-push) or high demand for popular artists (demand-pull).

description.en: The Phillips curve shows an inverse relationship between unemployment and inflation: when unemployment falls, inflation tends to rise, and vice versa.
description.hi: फिलिप्स वक्र बेरोजगारी और मुद्रास्फीति के बीच विपरीत संबंध दर्शाता है: जब बेरोजगारी घटती है, मुद्रास्फीति बढ़ती है।

topics.reason: The Phillips curve trade-off between unemployment and inflation is like balancing tempo and melody — changing one affects the other.

description.en: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is India's central bank. It controls monetary policy, regulates banks, manages currency, and maintains financial stability.
description.hi: भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक (आरबीआई) भारत का केंद्रीय बैंक है। यह मौद्रिक नीति नियंत्रित करता है और वित्तीय स्थिरता बनाए रखता है।

lyrics.en:
[Verse 1]
Reserve Bank of India, standing tall and strong,
Regulating money, making sure nothing goes wrong,
Banker to the banks, and to the government too,
Issuing currency — that's what central banks do.

[Chorus]
RBI, RBI — the guardian of the land,
Monetary policy shaped by a steady hand,
Controlling inflation, keeping growth on track,
The central bank ensures the economy won't crack.

[Verse 2]
Lender of last resort when banks are in distress,
Managing foreign exchange, cleaning up the mess,
From repo rates to CRR, the tools are in their hands,
The central bank conducts — and the economy expands.

topics.reason: The RBI conducts the economy like a music producer conducts an orchestra — setting the tempo, controlling the mix, maintaining harmony.

description.en: Money supply is the total amount of money circulating in the economy. The RBI controls it through various tools to maintain price stability and growth.
description.hi: मुद्रा आपूर्ति अर्थव्यवस्था में प्रचलित धन की कुल मात्रा है। आरबीआई विभिन्न उपकरणों से इसे नियंत्रित करता है।

topics.reason: Money supply in an economy is like the volume control in music — too much creates noise (inflation), too little leaves silence (recession).

description.en: Monetary policy uses interest rates and money supply to control inflation and stimulate economic growth. The RBI sets key rates like the repo rate.
description.hi: मौद्रिक नीति ब्याज दरों और मुद्रा आपूर्ति का उपयोग मुद्रास्फीति नियंत्रित करने और विकास को बढ़ावा देने के लिए करती है।

topics.reason: Monetary policy fine-tunes the economy like an equalizer adjusts frequencies — tweaking interest rates to get the right economic balance.

description.en: Fiscal policy uses government spending and taxation to influence the economy. Expansionary policy increases spending; contractionary policy reduces it.
description.hi: राजकोषीय नीति अर्थव्यवस्था को प्रभावित करने के लिए सरकारी खर्च और कराधान का उपयोग करती है।

topics.reason: Fiscal policy uses government spending and taxes like a DJ uses bass and treble — adjusting the mix to keep the economic party going.

description.en: Utility is the satisfaction a consumer gets from a good. Marginal utility is the extra satisfaction from one more unit — it usually decreases with each additional unit consumed.
description.hi: उपयोगिता वह संतुष्टि है जो उपभोक्ता को किसी वस्तु से मिलती है। सीमांत उपयोगिता एक और इकाई से मिलने वाली अतिरिक्त संतुष्टि है।

topics.reason: Consumer satisfaction from goods decreases with each unit, like how replaying a song too much reduces the thrill — that's diminishing marginal utility.

description.en: India's 1991 reforms introduced LPG: Liberalization (reducing restrictions), Privatization (selling government enterprises), and Globalization (opening to world markets).
description.hi: भारत के 1991 के सुधारों ने एलपीजी लाया: उदारीकरण (प्रतिबंध कम करना), निजीकरण (सरकारी उद्यम बेचना), और वैश्वीकरण (विश्व बाजारों के लिए खोलना)।

lyrics.en:
[Verse 1]
Nineteen ninety-one, the winds of change arrived,
Liberalization — Indian economy revived,
Privatization said let businesses run free,
Globalization opened doors for you and me.

[Chorus]
LPG — liberalize, privatize, go global wide,
Breaking down the barriers, opening up with pride,
India stepped into the world marketplace,
New Economic Policy gave the nation grace.

[Verse 2]
Fewer licenses, more freedom to compete,
Foreign investment flowing down every street,
The world became a market, borders started to fade,
India's new economic journey was finally made.

topics.reason: India's 1991 LPG reforms opened the economy to the world — like streaming platforms opened music to global audiences beyond borders.

description.en: The law of diminishing returns states that adding more of one input (while keeping others fixed) eventually produces smaller and smaller increases in output.
description.hi: ह्रासमान प्रतिफल का नियम कहता है कि एक आदान बढ़ाने से (अन्य स्थिर रखते हुए) अंततः उत्पादन वृद्धि कम होती जाती है।

topics.reason: Diminishing returns is like adding more instruments to a song — at first it sounds richer, but eventually it becomes cluttered noise.

description.en: Fixed costs don't change with output (rent). Variable costs do (raw materials). Total cost = fixed + variable. Average and marginal costs help firms decide optimal production.
description.hi: स्थिर लागत उत्पादन के साथ नहीं बदलती (किराया)। परिवर्तनीय लागत बदलती है (कच्चा माल)। कुल लागत = स्थिर + परिवर्तनीय।

topics.reason: Production costs are like making an album: studio rent is fixed cost, session musicians are variable cost — understanding both helps optimize the budget.

description.en: Management is the process of planning, organizing, leading, and controlling resources to achieve organizational goals efficiently and effectively.
description.hi: प्रबंधन संगठनात्मक लक्ष्यों को प्राप्त करने के लिए संसाधनों की योजना, संगठन, नेतृत्व और नियंत्रण की प्रक्रिया है।

lyrics.en:
[Verse 1]
Planning, organizing, leading every day,
Controlling all the resources in a systematic way,
That's management — the art of getting things done right,
Through people and processes, keeping goals in sight.

[Chorus]
Manage well, manage smart,
Every function plays its part,
From the vision to the action on the ground,
Management is where success is found.

[Verse 2]
Efficiency means doing things the right way,
Effectiveness means doing the right things every day,
Combine them both and watch the organization grow,
Management's the engine — now you're in the know.

topics.reason: Managing an organization is like producing a hit album — it requires planning, organizing talent, leading the vision, and controlling quality.

description.en: Key management thinkers: F.W. Taylor (scientific management), Henry Fayol (14 principles of management), and Elton Mayo (human relations and Hawthorne studies).
description.hi: प्रमुख प्रबंधन विचारक: टेलर (वैज्ञानिक प्रबंधन), फेयोल (प्रबंधन के 14 सिद्धांत), और मेयो (मानवीय संबंध)।

topics.reason: Taylor, Fayol, and Mayo each brought a different perspective to management — like how different producers bring unique styles to music.

description.en: Planning means setting goals and deciding how to achieve them. Strategic management involves long-term decisions about direction, considering constraints and trade-offs.
description.hi: योजना का अर्थ है लक्ष्य निर्धारित करना और उन्हें प्राप्त करने का तरीका तय करना। रणनीतिक प्रबंधन दीर्घकालिक निर्णय लेता है।

topics.reason: Planning in management is like composing a song — you set the structure, make creative decisions, and work within constraints to create something great.

description.en: Line organization has a direct chain of command. Staff organization adds specialist advisors. Most firms use a combination of both structures.
description.hi: लाइन संगठन में सीधी कमान श्रृंखला होती है। स्टाफ संगठन विशेषज्ञ सलाहकार जोड़ता है।

topics.reason: Organization structure is like a band setup — the lead singer (line) performs directly while backup vocalists and technicians (staff) provide support.

description.en: Delegation means assigning authority and responsibility to subordinates. It empowers employees and helps managers focus on higher-level strategic tasks.
description.hi: प्रत्यायोजन का अर्थ है अधीनस्थों को अधिकार और जिम्मेदारी सौंपना। यह कर्मचारियों को सशक्त बनाता है।

topics.reason: Delegation is like a band leader trusting each musician to play their part — sharing responsibility creates a better overall performance.

description.en: HRM deals with recruiting, training, compensating, and retaining employees. People are an organization's most valuable resource.
description.hi: मानव संसाधन प्रबंधन भर्ती, प्रशिक्षण, मुआवजा और कर्मचारी प्रतिधारण से संबंधित है।

topics.reason: HRM is like talent management in the music industry — finding the right artists, developing their skills, and keeping them motivated.

description.en: Effective leadership inspires teams toward shared goals. Motivation drives performance. Together, leadership and motivation create high-performing teams.
description.hi: प्रभावी नेतृत्व टीमों को साझा लक्ष्यों की ओर प्रेरित करता है। प्रेरणा प्रदर्शन को बढ़ाती है।

topics.reason: Great teams need great leadership and motivation — like a band that plays together in sync, inspired by a shared musical vision.

description.en: Maslow's hierarchy of needs, Herzberg's two-factor theory (hygiene and motivators), and McClelland's achievement theory each explain what drives people to perform at work.
description.hi: मास्लो की आवश्यकताओं का पदानुक्रम, हर्ज़बर्ग का द्वि-कारक सिद्धांत, और मैक्लेलैंड का उपलब्धि सिद्धांत कार्य प्रेरणा समझाते हैं।

lyrics.en:
[Verse 1]
Maslow built a pyramid of human needs,
From food and shelter up to where achievement leads,
Physiological, safety, love, esteem, and more,
Self-actualization sits right at the top floor.

[Chorus]
What motivates us? What makes us strive?
Herzberg said two factors keep the workplace alive,
Hygiene keeps dissatisfaction at bay,
Motivators are what make us love the working day.

[Verse 2]
McClelland spoke of achievement, power, and affiliation,
Three needs that drive us in every situation,
Understanding motivation helps a leader see,
What inspires their team to be the best they can be.

topics.reason: Maslow, Herzberg, and McClelland explain what drives people — just as rhythm, melody, and lyrics each contribute to what makes a song memorable.

description.en: Controlling ensures actual performance matches planned goals. Quality control maintains product standards through inspection, feedback, and corrective action.
description.hi: नियंत्रण सुनिश्चित करता है कि वास्तविक प्रदर्शन नियोजित लक्ष्यों से मेल खाता है। गुणवत्ता नियंत्रण उत्पाद मानक बनाए रखता है।

topics.reason: Quality control in management is like sound engineering — constant monitoring and adjustments ensure the final product meets the highest standards.

description.en: Organizations have four key functional areas: Finance (money management), Marketing (selling products), Human Resources (managing people), and Operations (production processes).
description.hi: संगठनों में चार प्रमुख कार्यात्मक क्षेत्र हैं: वित्त, विपणन, मानव संसाधन, और संचालन।

topics.reason: Finance, marketing, HR, and operations work together like instruments in an orchestra — each plays a distinct role in the organization's symphony.

description.en: Dalton proposed that matter is made of indivisible atoms; atoms of the same element are identical; atoms combine in fixed ratios to form compounds; atoms cannot be created or destroyed in chemical reactions.

[Chorus]

description.en: Rutherford fired alpha particles at a gold foil and observed that most passed through but some deflected back, proving that an atom has a small dense positively charged nucleus surrounded by mostly empty space.

description.en: Bohr proposed that electrons revolve around the nucleus in fixed circular orbits called shells or energy levels, and energy is emitted or absorbed only when electrons jump between these levels.

description.en: Orbits are fixed circular paths around the nucleus (Bohr model) whereas orbitals are three-dimensional probability regions where an electron is most likely to be found (quantum model).

description.en: No two electrons in an atom can have the same set of four quantum numbers. This means each orbital can hold a maximum of two electrons and they must have opposite spins.
description.hi: किसी परमाणु में कोई भी दो इलेक्ट्रॉन चारों क्वांटम संख्याओं का एक समान समुच्चय नहीं रख सकते। इसका अर्थ है कि प्रत्येक कक्षक में अधिकतम दो इलेक्ट्रॉन हो सकते हैं और उनकी चक्रण दिशाएं विपरीत होनी चाहिए।

description.en: Electrons fill orbitals of the same energy level (degenerate orbitals) one by one before pairing up, and all unpaired electrons have the same spin direction. This minimizes electron-electron repulsion.
description.hi: इलेक्ट्रॉन समान ऊर्जा स्तर के कक्षकों में एक-एक करके भरते हैं, युग्मित होने से पहले, और सभी अयुग्मित इलेक्ट्रॉनों की चक्रण दिशा एकसमान होती है। इससे इलेक्ट्रॉन-इलेक्ट्रॉन प्रतिकर्षण कम होता है।

संख्यात्मक प्रश्नों को सही तरह सुलझाओ।

[पुल — मुख्य शब्द]
संख्यात्मक, pH गणना, pOH, [H+], [OH-], Kw, 10^-14, आयनीकरण की डिग्री, दुर्बल अम्ल, सूत्र —
इन्हें बोलो, दोहराओ,
हर मुख्य शब्द पक्का करो।

description.en: A mole is the amount of substance containing 6.022 × 10^23 elementary entities, called Avogadro number. Moles connect measurable mass to number of particles through molar mass.
description.hi: मोल पदार्थ की वह मात्रा है जिसमें 6.022 × 10^23 कण होते हैं, जिसे अवोगाद्रो संख्या कहते हैं। मोलर द्रव्यमान के माध्यम से मोल द्रव्यमान और कणों की संख्या को जोड़ता है।

lyrics.en:
[Verse 1]
One mole is a counting unit for particles in the crowd,
Avogadro's number, 6.022 × 10²³, speaks aloud.
Atoms, molecules, ions — the count becomes precise,
Moles turn the microscopic world into a useful size.

[Chorus]
Mole, mole — count the tiny things,
6.022 × 10²³ is what the number brings.
Atoms, molecules, ions in one grand array,
Avogadro number helps us count the microscopic way.

[Bridge — Key Terms]
mole, Avogadro number, 6.022 × 10^23, particles, molar mass, amount of substance —
Speak them out, say them clear,
Every keyword, lock it here.
lyrics.hi:
[अंतरा 1]
एक मोल कणों को गिनने की इकाई है,
अवोगाद्रो संख्या 6.022 × 10²³ यही बुनियाद है।
परमाणु, अणु, आयन सबका गिनना आसान,
मोल सूक्ष्म जगत को दे मापने का मान।

[मुखड़ा]
मोल, मोल — कणों की गिनती,
6.022 × 10²³ इसकी निश्चित संख्या बनती।
परमाणु, अणु, आयन की पहचान,
अवोगाद्रो संख्या रखो ध्यान।

[पुल — मुख्य शब्द]
मोल, अवोगाद्रो संख्या, 6.022 × 10^23, कण, मोलर द्रव्यमान, पदार्थ की मात्रा —
इन्हें बोलो, दोहराओ,
हर मुख्य शब्द पक्का करो।

description.en: Atomic number (Z) is the number of protons; in a neutral atom it also equals the number of electrons. Mass number (A) is the total number of protons and neutrons: A = Z + N.
description.hi: परमाणु क्रमांक (Z) प्रोटॉनों की संख्या है; उदासीन परमाणु में यह इलेक्ट्रॉनों की संख्या के बराबर होता है। द्रव्यमान संख्या (A) प्रोटॉन और न्यूट्रॉन का कुल योग है: A = Z + N।

lyrics.en:
[Verse 1]
Atomic number counts the protons in the core,
Mass number counts protons plus neutrons and more.
Z tells identity, A tells the total inside,
Electrons match protons when the atom is neutral by side.

[Chorus]
Z is atomic number, A is mass number,
Protons give identity, neutrons add to the sum.
A = Z + N, keep the relation clear,
Atom structure gets easier when these symbols are near.

[Bridge — Key Terms]
atomic number, Z, protons, electrons, mass number, A, neutrons, A = Z + N —
Speak them out, say them clear,
Every keyword, lock it here.
lyrics.hi:
[अंतरा 1]
परमाणु क्रमांक नाभिक के प्रोटॉन गिने,
द्रव्यमान संख्या प्रोटॉन + न्यूट्रॉन मिले।
Z से तत्व की पहचान, A से कुल मान,
उदासीन परमाणु में इलेक्ट्रॉन प्रोटॉन समान।

[मुखड़ा]
Z है परमाणु क्रमांक, A है द्रव्यमान संख्या,
प्रोटॉन दें पहचान, न्यूट्रॉन जोड़ें कुल संख्या।
A = Z + N याद रखो साथ,
परमाणु संरचना समझो इस बात से साफ।

परमाणु क्रमांक, Z, प्रोटॉन, इलेक्ट्रॉन, द्रव्यमान संख्या, A, न्यूट्रॉन, A = Z + N —
इन्हें बोलो, दोहराओ,
हर मुख्य शब्द पक्का करो।

description.en: Isotopes have the same atomic number but different mass numbers, while isobars have the same mass number but different atomic numbers.
description.hi: समस्थानिकों का परमाणु क्रमांक समान लेकिन द्रव्यमान संख्या अलग होती है, जबकि समभारिकों की द्रव्यमान संख्या समान लेकिन परमाणु क्रमांक अलग होता है।

lyrics.en:
[Verse 1]
Isotopes share the same atomic number, different mass in view,
Same protons, different neutrons — that's the clue.
Isobars share the same mass number, different Z in the frame,
Different elements, same A — remember the game.

[Chorus]
Isotopes — same Z, different A,
Isobars — same A, different Z, that's the way.
Protons, neutrons, compare the two,
One quick pattern tells you what is true.

[Bridge — Key Terms]
isotopes, isobars, atomic number, mass number, same Z, different A, same A, different Z —
Speak them out, say them clear,
Every keyword, lock it here.
lyrics.hi:
[अंतरा 1]
समस्थानिकों का परमाणु क्रमांक समान रहे,
द्रव्यमान संख्या अलग, न्यूट्रॉन बदलें।
समभारिकों में द्रव्यमान संख्या समान,
पर Z अलग — अलग तत्व की पहचान।

[मुखड़ा]
समस्थानिक — Z समान, A अलग,
समभारिक — A समान, Z अलग।
प्रोटॉन-न्यूट्रॉन की गिनती देखो,
दो पैटर्न से पहचान सटीक लिखो।

समस्थानिक, समभारिक, परमाणु क्रमांक, द्रव्यमान संख्या, समान Z, अलग A, समान A, अलग Z —
इन्हें बोलो, दोहराओ,
हर मुख्य शब्द पक्का करो।

description.en: The four quantum numbers describe an electron: principal n, azimuthal l, magnetic m, and spin s. They specify energy level, subshell, orbital orientation, and spin.
description.hi: चार क्वांटम संख्याएँ इलेक्ट्रॉन का वर्णन करती हैं: मुख्य n, आज़िमुथल l, चुंबकीय m और स्पिन s। ये ऊर्जा स्तर, उपकोश, कक्षक की दिशा और चक्रण बताते हैं।

lyrics.en:
[Verse 1]
Four quantum numbers describe an electron's place,
Principal n gives energy and shell space.
Azimuthal l gives subshell shape and type,
Magnetic m gives orientation, spin s gives the final stripe.

[Chorus]
n, l, m, s — four numbers in the line,
Principal, azimuthal, magnetic, spin.
Energy, shape, orientation, spin direction too,
Quantum numbers map the electron's view.

[Bridge — Key Terms]
quantum numbers, principal n, azimuthal l, magnetic m, spin s, energy level, subshell, orientation —
Speak them out, say them clear,
Every keyword, lock it here.
lyrics.hi:
[अंतरा 1]
चार क्वांटम संख्याएँ इलेक्ट्रॉन की बात बताएँ,
मुख्य n ऊर्जा स्तर और कोश दिखाएँ।
अज़ीमुथल l उपकोश और आकृति बताए,
चुंबकीय m दिशा, स्पिन s चक्रण समझाए।

[मुखड़ा]
n, l, m, s — चार नाम याद,
मुख्य, अज़ीमुथल, चुंबकीय, स्पिन का संवाद।
ऊर्जा, आकृति, अभिविन्यास, चक्रण की राह,
क्वांटम संख्याएँ देती इलेक्ट्रॉन की चाह।

[पुल — मुख्य शब्द]
क्वांटम संख्याएँ, मुख्य n, आज़िमुथल l, चुंबकीय m, स्पिन s, ऊर्जा स्तर, उपकोश, दिशा —
इन्हें बोलो, दोहराओ,
हर मुख्य शब्द पक्का करो।

description.en: For a fixed amount of gas, pressure, volume and absolute temperature are related by P1V1/T1 = P2V2/T2 when the amount of gas stays constant.
description.hi: निश्चित मात्रा की गैस के लिए दाब, आयतन और परम तापमान का संबंध P1V1/T1 = P2V2/T2 है, जब गैस की मात्रा स्थिर रहती है।

lyrics.en:
[Verse 1]
Pressure, volume, temperature moving as a team,
The combined gas law keeps the relationship clean.
P₁V₁/T₁ equals P₂V₂/T₂,
Keep temperature in Kelvin and the numbers come through.

[Chorus]
P, V, T together, read the gas law line,
Combined gas law keeps the ratios in design.
Change one value, track the others true,
Use Kelvin every time in the calculation you do.

[Bridge — Key Terms]
combined gas law, pressure, volume, temperature, P1V1/T1, P2V2/T2, Kelvin —
Speak them out, say them clear,
Every keyword, lock it here.
lyrics.hi:
[अंतरा 1]
दाब, आयतन, तापमान साथ बदलें,
संयुक्त गैस नियम तीनों को संभालें।
P₁V₁/T₁ = P₂V₂/T₂, सूत्र महान,
तापमान केल्विन में — यही पहचान।

[मुखड़ा]
P, V, T साथ — गैस नियम की बात,
संयुक्त गैस समीकरण रखो याद।
एक मान बदले तो बाकी का हिसाब,
केल्विन तापमान से सही जवाब।

[पुल — मुख्य शब्द]
संयुक्त गैस नियम, दाब, आयतन, तापमान, P1V1/T1, P2V2/T2, केल्विन —
इन्हें बोलो, दोहराओ,
हर मुख्य शब्द पक्का करो।

description.en: Water softening removes hardness-causing Ca2+ and Mg2+ ions. Common methods include ion exchange, zeolite treatment and synthetic resins.
description.hi: जल मृदुकरण में कठोरता पैदा करने वाले Ca2+ और Mg2+ आयनों को हटाया जाता है। सामान्य विधियों में आयन विनिमय, जिओलाइट उपचार और सिंथेटिक रेजिन शामिल हैं।

lyrics.en:
[Verse 1]
Hard water can be softened by removing the troublesome ions,
Ion exchange sends calcium and magnesium through new bonds.
Zeolite and resin systems can take their place,
Softening reduces hardness and improves the water's grace.

[Chorus]
Soften the water, take Ca²⁺ away,
Remove Mg²⁺ and make the water behave.
Ion exchange, zeolite, resin on the line,
Hardness goes down and the water turns fine.

[Bridge — Key Terms]
water softening, hardness, Ca2+, Mg2+, ion exchange, zeolite, resin —
Speak them out, say them clear,
Every keyword, lock it here.
lyrics.hi:
[अंतरा 1]
कठोर जल से कैल्शियम-मैग्नीशियम हटाएँ,
आयन विनिमय से कठोरता कम कराएँ।
ज़ियोलाइट और रेज़िन अपना काम करें,
Ca²⁺, Mg²⁺ हटाकर जल को नरम करें।

[मुखड़ा]
जल मृदुकरण — कठोरता को घटाओ,
Ca²⁺, Mg²⁺ को हटाओ।
आयन विनिमय, ज़ियोलाइट, रेज़िन का ज्ञान,
कठोर जल को नरम बनाना यही समाधान।

[पुल — मुख्य शब्द]
जल मृदुकरण, कठोरता, Ca2+, Mg2+, आयन विनिमय, जिओलाइट, रेजिन —
इन्हें बोलो, दोहराओ,
हर मुख्य शब्द पक्का करो।

hi.title: Aaj Phir Jeene Ki Tamanna Hai

description.en: Corrosion is the gradual deterioration of a metal by chemical or electrochemical reaction with its environment. Rusting of iron can be reduced by painting, galvanizing and other protective methods.
description.hi: संक्षारण पर्यावरण के साथ रासायनिक या विद्युत-रासायनिक अभिक्रिया के कारण धातु का धीरे-धीरे क्षय है। लोहे की जंग को पेंटिंग, गैल्वनाइजिंग और अन्य सुरक्षात्मक विधियों से कम किया जा सकता है।

lyrics.en:
[Verse 1]
Corrosion is the slow attack that turns metal into a weaker state,
Electrochemical cells can set the process in motion and create the fate.
Anode oxidation, cathode reduction, electrons move through the path,
Painting and galvanizing help protect the metal from the attack.

[Chorus]
Corrosion, corrosion — stop the metal's fall,
Oxidation at the anode starts the chain for all.
Paint it, galvanize it, block the water and air,
Protect the metal surface, keep corrosion from there.

[Bridge — Key Terms]
corrosion, rusting, oxidation, electrochemical reaction, painting, galvanizing, protection —
Speak them out, say them clear,
Every keyword, lock it here.
lyrics.hi:
[अंतरा 1]
संक्षारण धातु को धीरे-धीरे कमजोर करे,
इलेक्ट्रोकेमिकल सेल इसकी प्रक्रिया धरे।
एनोड पर ऑक्सीकरण, कैथोड पर अपचयन,
इलेक्ट्रॉन के प्रवाह से चलता संक्षारण।

[मुखड़ा]
संक्षारण, संक्षारण — धातु को बचाना,
एनोड ऑक्सीकरण से प्रक्रिया पहचानना।
पेंटिंग, गैल्वनाइजिंग रक्षा का उपाय,
जल और वायु रोककर जंग को दूर भगाएँ भाई।

[पुल — मुख्य शब्द]
संक्षारण, जंग, ऑक्सीकरण, विद्युत-रासायनिक अभिक्रिया, पेंटिंग, गैल्वनाइजिंग, सुरक्षा —
इन्हें बोलो, दोहराओ,
हर मुख्य शब्द पक्का करो।

description.en: A continuous, differentiable curve that starts and ends at equal heights must have a flat tangent somewhere between.
description.hi: A continuous, differentiable curve that starts and ends at equal heights must have a flat tangent somewhere between.

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
Start at a, you end at b, and the heights are the same,
f of a equals f of b — that's the opening frame.
Somewhere in the middle there's a point we call c,
where the tangent lies flat — f dash c is zero, you see!
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
a pe shuru, b pe end, dono height ek samaan,
f(a) barabar f(b) — yahi shart ka bayaan.
beech mein ek point aaya, usko bolo c,
tangent bilkul flat — f dash c zero, dekh zaraa!

description.en: Somewhere the instantaneous slope equals the average rate of change — tangent parallel to the secant.
description.hi: Somewhere the instantaneous slope equals the average rate of change — tangent parallel to the secant.

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
Average rate, now meet the slope at c,
f dash c equals f of b minus f of a over b minus a.
Tangent parallel to the line through the ends,
LMVT is the rule that never bends!
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
average rate se milti hai slope point c pe,
f dash c barabar f(b) minus f(a) over b minus a.
secant ke parallel wahi tangent ki line,
LMVT ka rule, sab kuch fine!

description.en: Two functions compared by ratio — the bridge to L'Hôpital's rule.
description.hi: Two functions compared by ratio — the bridge to L'Hôpital's rule.

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
Two functions racing, compare the pace,
f dash c over g dash c — ratio in its place.
Net change over net change, equal they'll be,
building up the bridge to L'Hopital, see!
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
do functions ki race, ratio se tol,
f dash c over g dash c, yahi hai bol.
net change ka ratio barabar rahe,
L'Hopital tak ka pul yahi kahe!

description.en: Terms settle toward a limit L: past a threshold N they stay within any distance ε.
description.hi: Terms settle toward a limit L: past a threshold N they stay within any distance ε.

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
Numbers drifting one by one, taking their time,
settling soft toward a limit, finding their line.
Past a threshold N, the terms stay within epsilon — home,
bounded and monotone, no more to roam.
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
numbers dheere dheere limit ki ore,
lim a-n barabar L, settle hote more.
N ke baad, terms epsilon ke andar rahe,
bounded aur monotone — converge yeh kahe.

description.en: Infinite sums tested with D'Alembert's ratio test and Cauchy's root test.
description.hi: Infinite sums tested with D'Alembert's ratio test and Cauchy's root test.

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
Partial sums are climbing, do they stay or fly?
Run the ratio test to see if it's a lie.
L less than one they converge, greater than one goodbye,
Cauchy's root test checking as the terms go by.
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
partial sums chadhein, rukein ya udein?
ratio test lagao, sach keh dein.
L one se kam converge, one se zyada bye,
Cauchy root test bhi parakh le, try!

description.en: Any smooth function expands into an infinite polynomial around a point a.
description.hi: Any smooth function expands into an infinite polynomial around a point a.

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
Expand around a, term on term they grow,
f of a plus f dash a times x minus a, let it flow.
Successive derivatives stacking the sum,
Taylor's polynomial till the series is done.
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
point a ke aas paas, term pe term,
f(a) plus f dash a into x minus a badhta firm.
derivatives ki layer, sum banti jaaye,
Taylor ki series, dhun gungunaaye.

description.en: Taylor's series centred at the origin a = 0 — the standard eˣ, sin, cos expansions.
description.hi: Taylor's series centred at the origin a = 0 — the standard eˣ, sin, cos expansions.

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
Same as Taylor but we center at zero,
unplug the guitar, let the simple be the hero.
e to the x equals one plus x plus x squared over two,
Maclaurin keeps it honest, keeps it true.
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
Taylor hi hai par center zero pe,
simple si dhun, acoustic saaye pe.
e to the x barabar one plus x plus x squared over two,
Maclaurin saaf-suthra, dil mein basa le.

description.en: Limits whose direct value is undefined — need algebra or logs first.
description.hi: Limits whose direct value is undefined — need algebra or logs first.

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
Zero over zero, infinity fight,
the form's a disguise, it won't give you the light.
Factor it, log it, rationalize the frame,
reveal the true limit — that's the funky game.
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
zero bata zero, infinity ki jung,
form dhoka deti, na mile rang.
factor karo, log karo, rationalize zaraa,
asli limit nikaalo — funky adaa!

description.en: For 0/0 or ∞/∞, the ratio of limits equals the ratio of derivatives.
description.hi: For 0/0 or ∞/∞, the ratio of limits equals the ratio of derivatives.

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
Stuck on zero over zero? Don't you stall,
derivative on top and bottom, take them all.
Still indeterminate? Run it once more,
L'Hopital's the banger that settles the score!
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
zero over zero pe atke? mat ghabra,
upar neeche derivative, le le saara.
phir bhi indeterminate? dobaara chala,
L'Hopital banger, hisaab chuka!

description.en: A multivariable limit exists only if every path gives the same value L.
description.hi: A multivariable limit exists only if every path gives the same value L.

topics.formula: lim(x,y)→(a,b) f = L along EVERY path

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
Every path to a-b must agree,
approach from all sides for the limit to be.
One value L, no matter the way —
that's continuity on a 3D display.
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
har raaste se a-b tak pahucho,
sabhi directions se ek hi value soocho.
ek hi L, chaahe raah koi bhi ho,
3D surface pe continuity, slow-mo!

description.en: Differentiate one variable holding others constant; mixed partials are equal when continuous.
description.hi: Differentiate one variable holding others constant; mixed partials are equal when continuous.

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
Hold y still, differentiate x alone,
partial f partial x — one variable, own the zone.
Mixed partials equal, Clairaut makes it known,
f x y equals f y x, full grown.
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
y ko sthir rakho, x pe differentiate,
partial f partial x — ek variable, concentrate.
mixed partials barabar, Clairaut kahe,
f x y barabar f y x rahe.

description.en: Expand a 2-variable surface: tangent plane, then curvature from second partials.
description.hi: Expand a 2-variable surface: tangent plane, then curvature from second partials.

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
Tangent plane rising, approximate it true,
h times f x plus k times f y, the first-order view.
Then curve the surface with the second-order sound,
multi-variable Taylor spinning all around.
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
tangent plane se surface ko chhuo,
h into f x plus k into f y, first order suno.
phir second order se curve ko ghoomao,
do variable ka Taylor, dhun mein jhoomao.

description.en: Critical points where fₓ=f_y=0, classified by the Hessian discriminant D.
description.hi: Critical points where fₓ=f_y=0, classified by the Hessian discriminant D.

topics.formula: D = rt − s² ; r=f_xx, s=f_xy, t=f_yy

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
f x equals zero, f y equals zero, the critical sign,
now test it with the Hessian, draw the line.
D equals r t minus s squared tells you the fate:
peak, or valley, or a saddle — calculate!
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
f x zero, f y zero, critical sign,
Hessian se test karo, kheencho line.
D barabar r t minus s squared bataaye naseeb,
peak, valley ya saddle — kareeb!

description.en: Optimize under a constraint by setting gradients parallel via multiplier λ.
description.hi: Optimize under a constraint by setting gradients parallel via multiplier λ.

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
Constraint on the path, you can't break the wall,
set the gradients parallel, answer the call.
grad f equals lambda grad g, lock the flow,
constrained optimum — that's the way to go.
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
constraint ki deewar, tod na sako,
gradients parallel, jawaab pao.
grad f barabar lambda grad g, flow ko baandho,
constrained optimum — raasta saadho.

description.en: Spin a 2D region about an axis to sweep out a 3D volume (disk / washer).
description.hi: Spin a 2D region about an axis to sweep out a 3D volume (disk / washer).

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
Spin the curve around the line, watch it grow,
disks stacking up in a 3D show.
V equals pi integral f of x squared d x, the beat spins,
volume of revolution — that's how it begins.
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
curve ko axis ke gird ghumao,
disks jama ke 3D dikhao.
V barabar pi integral f of x squared d x, beat spin,
volume of revolution — ab begin!

description.en: Wrap a curve's arc around an axis to get the lateral surface area.
description.hi: Wrap a curve's arc around an axis to get the lateral surface area.

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
Wrap the arc around, the bands of the shell,
slant length d s does the job so well.
S equals two pi integral y root one plus y dash squared d x,
surface of revolution, catchy and complex.
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
arc ko lapet do, shell ke band,
slant length d s kaam karein grand.
S barabar two pi integral y root one plus y dash squared d x,
surface of revolution — catchy complex!

description.en: Integration over infinite bounds or through an asymptote, taken as a limit.
description.hi: Integration over infinite bounds or through an asymptote, taken as a limit.

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
Bounds at infinity, the melody drifts,
a limit takes the stand as the boundary shifts.
Integral a to infinity equals the limit of a to t,
finite means converge, else diverge, you see.
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
infinity pe bounds, dhun bahe,
limit sambhaale jab boundary dhahe.
Integral a to infinity barabar limit a to t,
finite toh converge, warna diverge, dekh le.

description.en: Euler's first integral — symmetric, links trig integrals and factorials.
description.hi: Euler's first integral — symmetric, links trig integrals and factorials.

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
Euler's first integral, zero to one glide,
B m n equals integral zero to one, x to m minus one, one minus x to n minus one.
Symmetric and soulful, B m n equals B n m,
R and B of the integrals, flowing like a gem.
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
Euler ka pehla integral, zero se one,
B m n barabar integral zero to one, x to m minus one, one minus x to n minus one.
symmetric soulful, B m n barabar B n m,
integrals ka R and B, bahta gem!

description.en: The factorial extended to all reals, with Γ(n+1)=nΓ(n) and Γ(½)=√π.
description.hi: The factorial extended to all reals, with Γ(n+1)=nΓ(n) and Γ(½)=√π.

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
Factorials continuous, crown of the reals,
Gamma n equals integral zero to infinity, x to n minus one, e to minus x.
Gamma n equals n minus one factorial the recurrence sings,
and Gamma half equals root pi — the secret it brings.
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
factorial continuous, reals ka taaj,
Gamma n barabar integral zero to infinity, x to n minus one, e to minus x.
Gamma n barabar n minus one factorial recurrence gaaye,
aur Gamma half barabar root pi raaz sunaaye.

description.en: Integrate over a 2D region for the volume under a surface (Fubini).
description.hi: Integrate over a 2D region for the volume under a surface (Fubini).

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
Layer upon layer across the plane,
bouncy little pop tune, do it again.
Double integral over R, f of x y, d A, Fubini's delight,
inner then outer, integrate it right.
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
plane pe layer pe layer chadhe,
halki si pop dhun, phir se badhe.
Double integral over R, f of x y, d A, Fubini pyaar,
inner phir outer — integrate, yaar!

description.en: Sketch the region and swap inner/outer limits to the opposite strips.
description.hi: Sketch the region and swap inner/outer limits to the opposite strips.

topics.formula: ∫∫ f dy dx  ⇄  ∫∫ f dx dy

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
Sketch the region, feel the funky bass,
vertical strips to horizontal, change the space.
Swap d y d x to d x d y, re-bound the floor,
change of order groove makes the hard one score.
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
region ko sketch karo, funky bass,
vertical se horizontal, badlo space.
d y d x ko d x d y mein lao,
change of order groove — easy banao.

description.en: Transform coordinates and rescale area by the Jacobian determinant |J|.
description.hi: Transform coordinates and rescale area by the Jacobian determinant |J|.

topics.formula: ∬ f dx dy = ∬ f |J| du dv ; polar J=r

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
New coordinates dropping, don't lose the ground,
scale the area by the Jacobian J, spin it around.
Polar gives J equals r, d A equals r d r d theta,
Jacobian in the bass, transform and go!
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
naye coordinates, zameen na chhoote,
area ko Jacobian J se scale karo, loot le.
polar mein J barabar r, d A barabar r d r d theta,
Jacobian bass mein — transform, chalo!

description.en: Set the integrand to 1 and the double integral returns plain area.
description.hi: Set the integrand to 1 and the double integral returns plain area.

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
Set the function to one, nothing more to add,
melodic folk computes the area, not bad.
Area of R equals double integral d A, the region's embrace,
integrate the plane and you've measured the space.
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
function ko one karo, aur kuch nahi,
folk ki dhun area naap le wahi.
Area of R barabar double integral d A, region sang,
plane integrate karke naapa rang.

description.en: Integrate over a 3D solid for mass, centre of mass, moments.
description.hi: Integrate over a 3D solid for mass, centre of mass, moments.

topics.formula: ∭_V f(x,y,z) dV = ∫∫∫ f dz dy dx

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
Slice the solid across all three,
dance-pop dynamic as far as you see.
Triple integral over V, f of x y z, d V, layer the night,
triple integral spinning the 3D light.
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
solid ko kaato teeno dimension,
dance-pop dynamic, poori attention.
Triple integral over V, f of x y z, d V, raat saja,
triple integral — 3D jaga!

description.en: For spherical symmetry, convert to (ρ,θ,φ) with volume element ρ²sinφ.
description.hi: For spherical symmetry, convert to (ρ,θ,φ) with volume element ρ²sinφ.

topics.formula: dV = ρ² sinφ dρ dθ dφ

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
Cartesian to spherical, cosmic and wide,
synthwave carries the grid as your guide.
d V equals rho squared sine phi, d rho d theta d phi,
radial and angular, drifting high.
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
Cartesian se spherical, cosmic si raah,
synthwave le chale grid ko, wah.
d V barabar rho squared sine phi, d rho d theta d phi,
radial angular — bahta sukoon, aah.

description.en: For axial symmetry, polar in the plane plus height z.
description.hi: For axial symmetry, polar in the plane plus height z.

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
Round the axis symmetry spins the swing,
polar plus a height, let the cylinder sing.
d V equals r, d r d theta d z, the groove's in gear,
cylindrical coordinates, loud and clear.
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
axis ke gird symmetry ka swing,
polar plus height, cylinder sing.
d V barabar r, d r d theta d z, gear mein groove,
cylindrical coordinates — loud move!

description.en: Set the integrand to 1 over a 3D region for the enclosed volume.
description.hi: Set the integrand to 1 over a 3D region for the enclosed volume.

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
Sum the tiny blocks d V in the frame,
fast-paced bars computing, that's the game.
Volume of V equals triple integral d V, stack them high,
complete 3D structure reaching for the sky.
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
chhote blocks d V ko jodo frame,
fast bars compute karein, yahi game.
Volume of V barabar triple integral d V, high jama,
poora 3D structure — aasmaan chhuaa!

description.en: Points in the direction of maximum increase, normal to level surfaces.
description.hi: Points in the direction of maximum increase, normal to level surfaces.

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
Point to the steepest, that's the vow,
grad phi shows the fastest climb right now.
Magnitude the max rate, normal to the shell,
gradient's the synth-pop that leads you well.
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
sabse steep ki ore ishaara,
grad phi dikhaaye chadhaav saara.
magnitude max rate, surface pe normal,
gradient synth-pop — raasta formal!

description.en: Rate of change in a chosen direction, from the gradient dotted with it.
description.hi: Rate of change in a chosen direction, from the gradient dotted with it.

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
Any direction you want to know,
smooth soul groove tells you how it'll flow.
D u phi equals grad phi dot u hat, the dot does its part,
directional derivative straight from the heart.
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
jis direction chaho rate jaano,
smooth soul groove, flow pehchaano.
D u phi barabar grad phi dot u hat, dot ka khel,
directional derivative — dil se mel!

description.en: Net outward flux per unit volume — source, sink, or solenoidal.
description.hi: Net outward flux per unit volume — source, sink, or solenoidal.

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
Source or a sink, feel the flow,
div F, grad dot F tells you where it'll go.
Pumping EDM, flux pouring out the frame,
positive divergence — the source is the name.
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
source ya sink, flow ko mehsoos,
div F, grad dot F bataaye rukh.
pumping EDM, flux bahe frame se,
positive divergence — source ke naam se!

description.en: Local rotational circulation; zero curl means irrotational / conservative.
description.hi: Local rotational circulation; zero curl means irrotational / conservative.

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
Spin it, swirl it, round it goes,
curl F, grad cross F — the rotation knows.
Electro-swing circulation, feel the twist,
zero curl means irrotational — can't resist.
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
ghumao, bhanwar, round yeh jaaye,
curl F, grad cross F rotation samjhaaye.
electro-swing circulation, twist ka maza,
zero curl toh irrotational — adaa!

description.en: Irrotational fields have a scalar potential; line integrals are path-independent.
description.hi: Irrotational fields have a scalar potential; line integrals are path-independent.

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
Irrotational calm, a potential found,
lo-fi settles soft on steady ground.
F equals grad phi, the path won't matter,
line integral equals phi B minus phi A, nothing to shatter.
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
irrotational shaant, potential mile,
lo-fi settle ho steady zameen pe chale.
F barabar grad phi, raah na fark pade,
line integral barabar phi B minus phi A — kuch na bigde.

description.en: Satisfies Laplace's equation — steady-state, source-free equilibrium.
description.hi: Satisfies Laplace's equation — steady-state, source-free equilibrium.

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
Steady state calm, no source inside,
acoustic harmony as the fields subside.
Laplacian of phi equals zero, Laplace as the guide,
harmonic and even, equilibrium's pride.
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
steady state shaant, andar na source,
acoustic harmony, fields ka course.
Laplacian of phi barabar zero, Laplace guide,
harmonic even — equilibrium pride.

description.en: Tangential component along a curve — the work done along the path.
description.hi: Tangential component along a curve — the work done along the path.

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
Trace the path, the field does its pay,
indie folk journey along the way.
Line integral over C, F dot d r, the work is found,
tangential components summing all around.
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
raah ko trace karo, field de daam,
indie folk safar, chalta kaam.
Line integral over C, F dot d r, work mil jaaye,
tangential components jud ke aaye.

description.en: Normal component across a surface — the total flux through it.
description.hi: Normal component across a surface — the total flux through it.

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
Flux through the surface, components add,
dance-pop energy, never sad.
Double integral over S, F dot n hat, d S, the flow goes through,
surface integral counting it for you.
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
surface se flux, components add,
dance-pop energy, kabhi na sad.
Double integral over S, F dot n hat, d S, flow guzre,
surface integral — gin le saare!

description.en: Links a closed line integral in the plane to a double integral of circulation.
description.hi: Links a closed line integral in the plane to a double integral of circulation.

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
Close the loop in the plane, link the two,
rapid-fire bars connecting the view.
Closed integral M d x plus N d y equals double integral N x minus M y,
Green's theorem flipping the boundary high.
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
plane mein loop band, dono jodo,
rapid bars se view ko modo.
Closed integral M d x plus N d y barabar double integral N x minus M y,
Green's theorem — boundary set right, chalo!

description.en: Generalises Green to 3D: boundary line integral equals surface integral of curl.
description.hi: Generalises Green to 3D: boundary line integral equals surface integral of curl.

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
Boundary line to the curl on the sheet,
cinematic swell makes the theorem complete.
Closed integral F dot d r equals double integral curl F dot n hat d S,
Stokes unites the edge and the sheet.
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
boundary line se curl ki sheet,
cinematic swell — theorem complete.
Closed integral F dot d r barabar double integral curl F dot n hat d S,
Stokes jode edge aur sheet, neat!

description.en: Outward flux through a closed surface equals the volume integral of divergence.
description.hi: Outward flux through a closed surface equals the volume integral of divergence.

lyrics.en:
[Verse]
Flux across the surface, divergence in the core,
what flows out the boundary is what the volume store.
Closed surface F dot n hat d S equals triple integral div F d V,
Gauss's law of the volumes, the balance you adore.
lyrics.hi:
[Verse]
surface se flux, core mein divergence,
jo bahe boundary, wahi volume ki essence.
Closed surface F dot n hat d S barabar triple integral div F d V,
Gauss ka law — balance ki existence!
